mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent GDP declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS declines do not correlate with subsequent GDP declines.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative equity returns.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, the combination signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low UNRATE and rising PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent negative equity returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% signals weakening supply-side activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO declines in late-cycle do not correlate with subsequent negative equity returns.
